notes.title: Death Relives – Second Update Now Live
notes.content:
[h3][b]🔧 Death Relives – Second Patch Notes
Based on community feedback, this second patch brings several improvements aimed at making the gameplay experience smoother and more balanced:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🌱 Gameplay Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]• 🧭 The difficulty of the attic seer encounter has been reduced.
• 🫣 Inventory can now be accessed while hiding.
• 🧠 Enemy AI behavior has been improved; it now puts less pressure on the player.
• 🔊 Sounds triggered during puzzle solving now alert Xipe Totec less frequently.
• ✨ Collectible items are now more visible and easier to spot.
• 🩸 When injecting blood into the seed, Xipe Totec now spawns farther away from the player.
• ⏱️ Xipe Totec’s arrival to upper floors has been delayed, giving players more breathing room.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🛠️ Technical Fixes & Stability[/b][/p][p][b]• 🕳️ Screen tearing issues on consoles have been resolved.
• 🪟 Visual glitches on glass-like surfaces have been fixed.
• 🗡️ A bug related to the attic seer’s kill animation has been addressed.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to everyone who provided feedback.
[b]Death Relives continues to grow with your support.[/b][/p][p]— [i]Nyctophile Studios[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Death Relives – First Patch Released
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Death Relives players,[/h1][p][/p][p]Since the full release of our game, we've been closely following your feedback. Due to certain issues that prevented some players from progressing, we wanted to share this first patch with you earlier than planned.[/p][p]This is not a major update. However, since some of the technical issues directly affected gameplay, we wanted to deliver these fixes without delay.[/p][p]Our goal is to quickly resolve the problems faced by new players—especially those encountered in the early stages—and ensure everyone can enjoy the atmosphere of the game without interruption.[/p][p]With this first patch:[/p][p]Progress-blocking bugs have been fixed,
Stability and performance have been improved,
Minor gameplay adjustments have been made based on your feedback.[/p][p]This is only the beginning. With the upcoming patches, we’ll address remaining technical issues and bring new improvements to enrich your experience even further.[/p][p]Thank you from the bottom of our hearts to everyone who played the game, reported bugs, shared ideas, and supported us.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔧[/b] [b]Death Relives – First Patch Notes[/b]
In this first patch, released based on player feedback after the full launch, we have implemented the following adjustments and improvements:[/h3][hr][/hr][h3]🌱 [b]General Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][p]• [b]⏳ The decay timer for the seed has been extended; players now have more time to survive.
• 🧠 Xipe Totec’s AI behavior that caused constant chasing has been adjusted; his pursuit frequency and intensity have been reduced.
• 🤐 The coughing sound while wearing the cloak no longer alerts enemy AI.
• 🩸 The amount of collectible blood has been increased (from 1 to 3).
• 🏃 Movement speed while using the cloak has been increased.
• 💾 Save areas are now visible on the seed.
• 🫥 The frequency of enemy AI checking around hiding spots has been reduced.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]Technical Fixes and Stability[/b][/h3][p][b]• 🎵 The main menu sound issue has been resolved.
• ⚔️ Xipe Totec no longer repeatedly returns to the area when priests are stabbed.
• 🛡️ A visual shield has been added to prevent players from wasting bullets while Xipe Totec is invulnerable.
• ❌ Nvrtx support has been removed.
• 💡 Path Tracing support has been removed.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]Death Relives continues to evolve with your support.[/p][p]With love,
Nyctophile Studios[/p]

notes.title: Quick Time Event and Sounds - Some announcements
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Gamers,[/h2]

We are taking into consideration all the feedback you've provided us with. Additionally, by watching gameplay videos from various streamers, we've taken note of the deficiencies related to the game. Particularly, you've brought awareness to us regarding Quick Time Events. 
In the full version, we will introduce an accessibility feature for Quick Time Events, allowing those who don't enjoy them to progress through alternative gameplay. For now, we've reduced the Quick Time Events for the priests to one for a smoother gameplay experience. Furthermore, we've added sound to some death animations. We are considering making the sounds even more impactful in the full version of the game. Many people believe that the voice of God is created with an effect, but it is actually the ancient Nahuatl language used by the Aztecs. We collaborated with linguists to revive the Nahuatl language specifically for this game.

Thanks,
Bahtiyar Ardin
Creative Director
